Linear algebra (jax.scipy.linalg)

Source: R/scipy_linalg.R
scipy_linalg.Rd

Ports of the decompositions and solvers of jax.scipy.linalg. Inputs are promoted to an inexact dtype and most functions work on batches (leading dimensions). Functions that return tuples in JAX return unnamed lists: scipy_linalg_svd() gives list(u, s, vh), scipy_linalg_eigh() gives list(w, v), scipy_linalg_lu() gives list(p, l, u) (or list(pl, u)), scipy_linalg_qr() gives list(q, r) (plus the pivots, or only list(r) for mode = "r"), scipy_linalg_schur() gives list(t, z). The scipy arguments overwrite_a, overwrite_b, overwrite_c, check_finite, lwork, turbo, debug and lapack_driver are accepted and ignored, as in JAX.

Usage

scipy_linalg_cholesky(
  a,
  lower = FALSE,
  overwrite_a = FALSE,
  check_finite = TRUE
)

scipy_linalg_cho_factor(
  a,
  lower = FALSE,
  overwrite_a = FALSE,
  check_finite = TRUE
)

scipy_linalg_cho_solve(
  c_and_lower,
  b,
  overwrite_b = FALSE,
  check_finite = TRUE
)

scipy_linalg_svd(
  a,
  full_matrices = TRUE,
  compute_uv = TRUE,
  overwrite_a = FALSE,
  check_finite = TRUE,
  lapack_driver = "gesdd"
)

scipy_linalg_det(a, overwrite_a = FALSE, check_finite = TRUE)

scipy_linalg_eigh(
  a,
  b = NULL,
  lower = TRUE,
  eigvals_only = FALSE,
  overwrite_a = FALSE,
  overwrite_b = FALSE,
  turbo = TRUE,
  eigvals = NULL,
  type = 1L,
  check_finite = TRUE
)

scipy_linalg_schur(a, output = "real")

scipy_linalg_inv(a, overwrite_a = FALSE, check_finite = TRUE)

scipy_linalg_lu_factor(a, overwrite_a = FALSE, check_finite = TRUE)

scipy_linalg_lu_solve(
  lu_and_piv,
  b,
  trans = 0L,
  overwrite_b = FALSE,
  check_finite = TRUE
)

scipy_linalg_lu(a, permute_l = FALSE, overwrite_a = FALSE, check_finite = TRUE)

scipy_linalg_qr(
  a,
  overwrite_a = FALSE,
  lwork = NULL,
  mode = "full",
  pivoting = FALSE,
  check_finite = TRUE
)

scipy_linalg_qr_multiply(
  a,
  c,
  mode = "right",
  pivoting = FALSE,
  conjugate = FALSE,
  overwrite_a = FALSE,
  overwrite_c = FALSE
)

scipy_linalg_solve(
  a,
  b,
  lower = FALSE,
  overwrite_a = FALSE,
  overwrite_b = FALSE,
  debug = FALSE,
  check_finite = TRUE,
  assume_a = "gen"
)

scipy_linalg_solve_triangular(
  a,
  b,
  trans = 0L,
  lower = FALSE,
  unit_diagonal = FALSE,
  overwrite_b = FALSE,
  debug = NULL,
  check_finite = TRUE
)

scipy_linalg_hessenberg(
  a,
  calc_q = FALSE,
  overwrite_a = FALSE,
  check_finite = TRUE
)

Arguments

a, b

Arrays (a is a matrix or a batch of matrices).

lower

Whether the lower triangle is used (or returned).

overwrite_a, overwrite_b, overwrite_c, check_finite, lwork, turbo, debug, lapack_driver

Ignored (scipy compatibility).

c_and_lower

list(c, lower) as returned by scipy_linalg_cho_factor().

full_matrices

Whether to compute the full u and vh.

compute_uv

Whether to compute u and vh.

eigvals_only

Whether to return only the eigenvalues.

eigvals

Must be NULL (only the full spectrum is implemented).

type

Generalized problem type: 1 (a v = w b v), 2 (a b v = w v) or 3 (b a v = w v).

output

"real" or "complex" Schur form.

lu_and_piv

list(lu, piv) as returned by scipy_linalg_lu_factor().

trans

0 ("N"), 1 ("T") or 2 ("C"): which system to solve.

permute_l

Whether to return list(p %*% l, u).

mode

For qr: "full", "economic" or "r"; for qr_multiply: "right" (c %*% q) or "left" (q %*% c).

pivoting

Whether to use column pivoting (the pivots are 0-based).

c

Array multiplied by q.

conjugate

Whether to use the conjugate transpose of q.

assume_a

"gen", "sym", "her" or "pos" (only "pos" uses a Cholesky solve).

unit_diagonal

Whether the diagonal of a is assumed to be ones.

calc_q

Whether to also return the unitary factor q (list(h, q)).

Value

Arrays, or lists of arrays as described above.
